name: spell-util
description: Spell's bottom layer:  util, the helpers every package shares, and toolchain, the lint, tsconfig, decorators and global types every repo's configs use

scripts.ts: yarn workspaces foreach -W --exclude spell-util -pv --topological-dev -j 4 run ts
scripts.test: yarn workspaces foreach -W --exclude spell-util -pv -j 4 run test
scripts.lint: yarn workspaces foreach -W --exclude spell-util -pv -j 4 run lint
scripts.format: yarn workspaces foreach -W --exclude spell-util -pv -j 4 run format
scripts.review: yarn workspaces foreach -W --exclude spell-util -v run review
